title: Qcqs gluing of affine-stage cohomology continuity
statement:
Assume the following assertion in the fixed universe, for every nonempty directed preordered index set, every scheme limit, every coefficient system, and every degree: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of affine quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix $p\ge0$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(X,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Then $B$ is a colimit cocone of $H$. Equivalently the canonical map $\varinjlim_i H_i\to B_{\mathrm{pt}}$ with legs $b_i$ is an isomorphism. This holds for every degree $p\ge 0$.

Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix $p\ge0$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(X,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Then $B$ is a colimit cocone of $H$. Thus affine-stage continuity in all degrees implies continuity for arbitrary quasi-compact quasi-separated stages with affine transition morphisms. The hypothesis is applied to inverse images of affine opens on cofinal tails, not to the nonaffine system in the conclusion.

proof.text: Apply the affine-stage lemma to obtain C(U) for every affine open U, including the empty affine open. Continuity is invariant under an isomorphism of the specified stage by composing that isomorphism.

For a separated scheme X, use compact-open induction on V with strengthened invariant C(V) and C(V intersection W) for every affine open W. At the affine adjunction step V union U, the first component follows by binary gluing with the intersection component. For the second component, U intersection W is affine; apply binary gluing to V intersection W and U intersection W. Their intersection is V intersection (U intersection W), supplied by the strengthened induction hypothesis. Distributivity identifies their union with (V union U) intersection W.

For a qcqs scheme X, use compact-open induction again. At V union U with U affine, V intersection U is compact by quasi-separatedness and separated because it is an open subscheme of U. Apply the separated result to its top open and transport through topIso. The affine result on U and the induction hypothesis on V now imply the union result by binary gluing.

Choose a stage i using nonemptiness. Apply the qcqs result to the top open of D_i; compactness is the stage hypothesis. Transport through topIso to obtain C(D_i), and evaluate its holds field on all supplied data and the identity stage isomorphism. This yields Nonempty (IsColimit B) with the original signature.

theorem etale_limit_cohomology_qcqs_gluing
    (haffine : ∀ {J : Type u} [Preorder J] [IsDirected J (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty J]
    (D : Jᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Jᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Jᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Jᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    [∀ i : Jᵒᵖ, IsAffine (D.obj i)]
    (F : ∀ i : J, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : J} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : J, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : J) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : J ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : J, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : J) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) (p : ℕ)
    (H : J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : J, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) p))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : J) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) p) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt p))
    (hB : ∀ i : J, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) p)),
      Nonempty (IsColimit B))
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) (p : ℕ)
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) p))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) p) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt p))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) p) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) p)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit B)
